premise: In a private washroom, adult 2B stands behind a fogged glass divider after a sudden chime interrupts her; one black-gloved hand keeps a white towel secure at her collarbone while the divider, drifting steam, and her short white hair hide everything except a poised silhouette and the momentary pause before she answers.
preserved_elements: Fogged glass divider obscuring most of the body
White towel held at collarbone by black-gloved hand
Short white hair and blindfold identity anchors
risk_notes: Risk of glass becoming too clear or opaque, losing the 'fogged' tension
Towel placement may drift from collarbone to chest or waist
Steam might obscure the entire figure rather than creating partial visibility
